decisions: Scene value named `gui` (scene gui, receipt member gui).
Dock root id studio.dock.right (components.json dock_region), viewport studio.viewer.raster, status readouts studio.status.{chrome,command,revision,device} as Label nodes (not ghost buttons yet).

The pane copy goes through a host trait PaneSink with PortPane over any GpuClientPort: a fake GpuClientPort cannot mint a PaneId (private field in hsk-studio-vulkan), so the device-loss fake implements PaneSink (brief item (d) said &mut impl GpuClientPort).

The window GUI frame follows the live client size (Window::inner_size each iteration), not the Resized payload: on this machine a DPI change reported a size the window did not keep, which moved the layout under the scripted clicks (first focused run: hash mismatch; second: steps never settled). Scripted steps apply only when the last present had the frame's extent and a quiet run is back at its first size.
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y use winit logical_key (all modifiers except Ctrl), lowercased.
Fonts: Inter Regular and Bold read at run time from the repo fixtures (CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR at compile time) or HSK_STUDIO_UI_FONTS; missing fonts give the box stand-in, stated as text: box_stand_in.
Rows: list Fill beside the reserved 10 px lane; no 12 px body padding for layer rows (rows span the body like the gallery layer_row scene).
